LocatorProp.label: LocatorProp
LocatorProp.doc: Runs a Scanner and Pattern check around the candidate point and places Child Prop at valid surface hits.

AssignmentsProp.label: AssignmentsProp
AssignmentsProp.doc: Full decoupled prop distribution pipeline connecting PositionsProvider, Scanner, and Assignments.

BiomeRoot.label: Biome Root Output
BiomeRoot.doc: Master output node for a Biome definition. Connect your final Density, MaterialProvider, and Props here.

DimensionOutput.label: Dimension Output & Fallback
DimensionOutput.doc: Master Dimension Output node. Controls concentric zones, biome pools, landmarks, bounding radius (0=Infinite), and Outside-Bounds Fallback (DEFAULT_BIOMES, VOID, OCEAN, VANILLA_DEFAULT).

RadialZone.label: Radial Zone / Ring
RadialZone.doc: Concentric radial zone or ring (e.g. Central End Island 0..190, Void Moat 190..960, Outer Archipelago Islands 960+).

RingLandmarks.label: Ring Towers / Pillars
RingLandmarks.doc: Places a circular ring of procedural pillars or towers (e.g. 10 End Obsidian Pillars around (0,0)).

SpawnIslandAnchor.label: Spawn Island Anchor
SpawnIslandAnchor.doc: Sculpts a starter island at (0,0) with an optional center structure and exports a Hub Anchor for connecting procedural landmarks.

RelationalLandmark.label: Structure Landmark (A=>B)
RelationalLandmark.doc: Procedurally places 1 or more instances of a chosen Structure within [minDist, maxDist] of its Parent Hub and connects them with a bridge or road.

SubIslandCluster.label: Satellite Islands Cluster
SubIslandCluster.doc: Procedurally scatters satellite islands around a parent hub with an optional landmark structure on each island.

BiomeWeightEntry.label: Biome Weight & Pool Entry
BiomeWeightEntry.doc: Assigns a biome to the active dimension with configurable weight, cell size multiplier, and boundary blend width. Double-click header to edit this biome's terrain graph!
